searchText: <@!758579010027782144> we are getting RLPx messages with a prefix code of 0x04, but this is not specified in the RLPx protocol. Does Nethermind have extra messages built on top of RLPx? We either have an internal problem with RLP or our devp2p is not understanding Nethermind. I am getting messages over RLPx which have bodies of 1024 bytes, but if I inspect the body then the RLP states that it should be ~33k bytes and thus I cannot decode it Anyone know how to connect openethereum to eth stats server? cc: <@&595684226221735986>
